tagline.zh: 从一个品牌色派生整套系统:固定 H/C 展开 tone 阶、按角色映射语义色、再对每个组合跑 WCAG 对比度验证——管线化,不靠手感。
tagline.en: Derive a whole system from one brand color: expand a tone ramp at fixed H/C, map tones to semantic roles, then run every pairing through WCAG contrast gates — a pipeline, not vibes.

origin.zh: 派生机制来自 Material 3:每个关键色展开为 13 档 tonal palette、Tone 0–100=CIE L*(material-color-utilities/Android 文档,调研 06§5);角色映射对照 Radix 12 步语义色阶(调研 06§8);选色工作流(固定 L 只调 C/H、色相映射)来自 Evil Martians(调研 06§2);官方配套工具为 Material Theme Builder(调研 06§7)。
origin.en: The derivation mechanics come from Material 3: each key color expands into a 13-tone tonal palette with Tone 0–100 = CIE L* (material-color-utilities / Android docs, research 06 §5); role mapping follows the Radix 12-step scale (research 06 §8); the selection workflow (fix L, tune C/H, hue mapping) is Evil Martians' (research 06 §2); the official companion tool is Material Theme Builder (research 06 §7).

effect.zh: 品牌色相 H。默认 250° 取自补研 12§11 派生片段的 --brand: oklch(0.62 0.19 250);oklch 刻度色相经验映射:红≈20°、黄≈90°、绿≈140°、蓝≈220°、紫≈320°(Evil Martians,调研 06§2)。
effect.en: Brand hue H. Default 250° comes from the expansion snippet's --brand: oklch(0.62 0.19 250) (research 12 §11); the oklch-scale hue rule of thumb: red≈20°, yellow≈90°, green≈140°, blue≈220°, purple≈320° (Evil Martians, research 06 §2).

effect.zh: 品牌色明度 L(0–1)。固定 L 只调 C/H 是 OKLCH 工作流的核心:同一 L 的颜色感知亮度一致,文字对比度才可预测(Evil Martians,调研 06§2)。默认 0.62 取自补研 12§11 片段。
effect.en: Brand lightness L (0–1). Fixing L and only tuning C/H is the core of the OKLCH workflow: equal L means equal perceived lightness, which is what makes text contrast predictable (Evil Martians, research 06 §2). Default 0.62 from the expansion snippet (research 12 §11).

effect.zh: 品牌色度 C。实测上限约 0.37(P3 屏略高),MDN 理论上限 0.5 但注意 100%=0.4(Evil Martians/MDN,调研 06§1/§2);默认 0.19 取自补研 12§11 片段——该值在 L=0.62/H=250 已越 sRGB 域,按浏览器现状裁剪显示(本会话实测裁剪为 #0088F2,裁剪行为为调研 06§2 记载的 Chrome/Safari 现状)。
effect.en: Brand chroma C. Practical max ≈0.37 (slightly more on P3 screens); MDN's theoretical cap is 0.5, noting 100% = 0.4 (Evil Martians/MDN, research 06 §1/§2); default 0.19 from the expansion snippet (research 12 §11) — already outside sRGB at L=0.62/H=250, displayed clipped per current browser behavior (measured this session as #0088F2; clipping is the Chrome/Safari status quo recorded in research 06 §2).

effect.zh: JS 型参数:切换验证管线跑哪一侧。light=品牌色本身即 solid accent,配白字复核;dark=accent 跳到同色相 tone 80(M3 官方:暗色 primary #D0BCFF ≈ tone 80,调研 06§7),配低 tone 深字复核——正是「暗色 accent 提亮」惯例的机制化。
effect.en: JS-type param: selects which side of the pipeline runs. light = the brand color itself is the solid accent, audited against white text; dark = the accent jumps to tone 80 of the same hue (official M3: dark primary #D0BCFF ≈ tone 80, research 06 §7), audited against a low-tone dark text — mechanizing the 'dark accents brighten' convention.

note.zh: demo 用 oklch() 渲染色块:Baseline 2023-05(MDN,调研 06§1);越域颜色浏览器按现状裁剪(Chrome/Safari 直接裁 RGB,Evil Martians 实测,调研 06§2)。对比度计算在 JS 内联完成,不受浏览器支持影响。
note.en: The demo renders swatches with oklch(): Baseline since 2023-05 (MDN, research 06 §1); out-of-gamut colors are clipped per current browser behavior (Chrome/Safari still clip RGB rather than gamut-map, per Evil Martians' measurement, research 06 §2). Contrast math runs inline in JS and is unaffected by browser support.

fallback.zh: tone 阶色块用 oklch() 声明,老浏览器整条失效:先给每档写 hex 兜底(由同一换算生成),再用 @supports (color: oklch(0.7 0.1 200)) 覆写;越域档的 hex 取裁剪值(与浏览器现状一致)。
fallback.en: Tone swatches are declared with oklch(), which older browsers drop entirely: ship a plain hex fallback per step (generated by the same conversion), then override under @supports (color: oklch(0.7 0.1 200)); out-of-gamut steps use the clipped hex (matching current browser rendering).

use.zh: 从一粒品牌色展开全套 UI 色:tone 阶承载背景/表面/边框/文字的分工(Radix 12 步同构,调研 06§8)
use.en: Expanding one brand seed into a full UI palette: the tone ramp carries backgrounds, surfaces, borders and text (isomorphic to Radix's 12 steps, research 06 §8)

use.zh: 亮暗双主题从同一色相派生:亮侧取品牌 tone,暗侧 accent 跳 tone 80(M3 官方基线 #6750A4→#D0BCFF 即此惯例,调研 06§7)
use.en: Deriving light and dark themes from one hue: light takes the brand tone, dark jumps the accent to tone 80 (exactly the M3 baseline convention #6750A4→#D0BCFF, research 06 §7)

use.zh: 多品牌/白标产品:换种子色只换 H/C/L 三个数,语义角色与对比度管线全部复用
use.en: Multi-brand / white-label products: swapping the seed means changing three numbers (H/C/L); semantic roles and the contrast pipeline carry over untouched

use.zh: 设计-工程交接:派生规则写成函数(Material Theme Builder 同思路,调研 06§7),hex 不再手工挑
use.en: Design-to-engineering handoff: the derivation rules ship as a function (Material Theme Builder's same idea, research 06 §7); hex values stop being hand-picked

avoid.zh: 只信感知均匀就跳过对比度复核——Evil Martians 原文警示:仅靠 OKLCH 不能保证可访问性,还需校验对比度(调研 06§2)
avoid.en: Trusting perceptual uniformity and skipping the contrast audit — Evil Martians' own warning: OKLCH alone does not guarantee accessibility, verify contrast (research 06 §2)

avoid.zh: 把 oklch L 当作 CIE L*/tone 的精确换算——两者同尺度不同定义,demo 用 tone/100 直代 L 是近似,标注为近似
avoid.en: Treating oklch L as an exact conversion of CIE L*/tone — same scale, different definition; the demo's tone/100-for-L substitution is an approximation and is labeled as such

avoid.zh: 在 sRGB 域强行使用高色度值而不处理越域——Chrome/Safari 目前直接裁剪 RGB,色相会肉眼可见地偏移(调研 06§2)
avoid.en: Using high-chroma values in sRGB without handling overflow — Chrome/Safari currently clip RGB outright, visibly shifting the hue (research 06 §2)

avoid.zh: 手写 APCA 公式来复核文本阶——官方强制使用 apca-w3 包、不许自行实现(调研 06§18);demo 只用 WCAG 公式复核
avoid.en: Hand-rolling APCA math to audit text steps — the official repo mandates the apca-w3 package and forbids reimplementing the formula (research 06 §18); the demo audits with the WCAG formula only

a11y.zh: 验证管线的四道闸(WCAG 2.1,调研 06§17):正文 AA≥4.5:1、AAA≥7:1、大字(≥18pt 或 ≥14pt bold)减半、非文本(UI 边界/图标)≥3:1;判定用未舍入原值,4.499:1 不达标。本会话实测(默认值 H250/L0.62/C0.19,裁剪为 #0088F2):白字 3.62:1——过 3:1 大字/UI 档、不过正文 AA,这正是管线存在的意义;同色相 tone 80 配 tone 20 深字 8.81:1(AAA)。Radix 的做法是以 APCA Lc60/Lc90 定文本步(调研 06§8)。
a11y.en: Four gates in the pipeline (WCAG 2.1, research 06 §17): body AA≥4.5:1, AAA≥7:1, large text (≥18pt or ≥14pt bold) halved, non-text (UI boundaries/icons) ≥3:1; judged unrounded — 4.499:1 fails. Measured this session at the defaults (H250/L0.62/C0.19, clipped to #0088F2): white text 3.62:1 — passes the 3:1 large-text/UI gate but not body AA, which is exactly why the pipeline exists; same-hue tone 80 with tone 20 text measures 8.81:1 (AAA). Radix instead targets APCA Lc60/Lc90 for its text steps (research 06 §8).

goal.zh: 从一粒品牌色 oklch(L C H) 派生整套品牌色系统:固定 H/C 展开 13 档 tone 阶,映射 solid accent/container/表面/文字角色,亮暗两侧分别取色,并对每个文字/非文本组合跑 WCAG 4.5:1 与 3:1 复核。
goal.en: Derive a full brand color system from one seed oklch(L C H): expand a 13-tone ramp at fixed H/C, map solid accent / container / surface / text roles, pick light and dark sides separately, and audit every text and non-text pairing against WCAG 4.5:1 and 3:1.

acceptance.zh: tone 阶固定 H 与 C、只变 tone(0–100),不逐档手挑颜色
acceptance.en: The ramp holds H and C fixed and varies only tone (0–100); no per-step hand-picking

acceptance.zh: 亮色语境 accent 用品牌 tone 本身,暗色语境 accent 跳同色相 tone 80
acceptance.en: Light context uses the brand tone as accent; dark context jumps the accent to tone 80 of the same hue

acceptance.zh: 每个文字/背景组合给出对比度比值与 AA(4.5:1)/大字与 UI(3:1)判定,判定不四舍五入
acceptance.en: Every text/background pairing reports its ratio and AA (4.5:1) / large-text & UI (3:1) verdicts, judged unrounded

acceptance.zh: 越 sRGB 域的档位如实按裁剪值复核(或预先降色度),不假装域外颜色可显示
acceptance.en: Out-of-sRGB steps are audited at their clipped values (or pre-reduced in chroma) — never pretend out-of-gamut colors are displayable

acceptance.zh: 组件只消费语义角色变量(tone → 角色只发生在映射层),不直接引用 tone 值
acceptance.en: Components consume only semantic role variables (tone → role happens in the mapping layer), never tone values directly
